أبو عبد الله جعفر بن محمد الحسني

notes: the last link is Jabir; the Imam Abu Abdillah appears after the saying in a narrated encounter (Hannan presents the report to him and he speaks), so he is left out pending the ruling
وما رأيت محمديا قط يعدله is Sudayf's remark on Muhammad b. Ali, not a link; blessings are left out
